summary: ADR-0059 accepted 2026-08-18; valid published/LKG catalog may replay frozen selection over current selected bytes, yielding validator-owned successor context; selection hash omits source bytes; context hash binds selection, current source hashes, snapshot, locator output, decisions, predecessor; authority envelope covers governing ADRs/rules/policies/contracts/registries/successor kinds; stale freshness or query-quality issues may degrade unrelated execution only when selection, authority, modules, and read-set verify; publication failure never advances current/LKG and does not revoke valid LKG; selection, authority, contract, command/test, policy, protected-path, source-integrity, or Knowledge self-change failures block or require semantic review; rapid profile permits same-selection degraded successor for non-Knowledge changes but forbids publication/lifecycle/authority replacement; production/release requires current published knowledge, publication checks, and semantic-review evidence; extends ADR-0048/0050; supersedes only ADR-0057 stale-stop execution interpretation; publication gate, LKG integrity, authority, and source checks remain mandatory
